cost: Conservative O(sum n³ + M log M + emitted text bytes): each head can traverse closure and each modifier can walk n ancestors; retained mention strings/features can be O(N²) bytes. Recursive graph walks use explicit stacks but require acyclicity; no dimension cap.
description: Extract ordered nominal mentions and linguistic feature masks from valid document trees without reading Entity.
forward: is_head applies UPOS/role exclusions and optional idiom/compound switches. span_of traverses the head's allowed children then descendants; take first/last nonpunctuation/symbol and retain matching edge brackets. Coordination may emit full group and own span. build chooses pronoun table then ordered FEATS overrides, with number FEATS only when table number unknown; nonpronoun coordination forces PL and titles OR gender. Sort (sent,start,-end,head), dedup equal spans. A nominal (not coordinated) mention whose gender is still unknown takes gender, and animacy if unknown, from lexicon::noun_feats of its head lemma unless COREF_X has no-gender-table; the reason is kept in Mention.lexicon.
inverse: For mention vector V, compatible inputs are all documents/environment snapshots yielding V after projection and span dedup; ignored Entity, unrelated comments and some syntax/FEATS can vary. Text lowercasing and removed title information prevent unique source reconstruction.
limitations: No exhaustive closed-list validation or malformed/cyclic public documents; production rule accuracy is unmeasured.
Partial lexical syntax; no executable percentage surrogate; no corpus or universal proof.
state: Valid acyclic Document, COREF_MD snapshot, nominal head candidates and retained feature/text projections.
